text:
You're not broke. You're running the wrong mental stream.

It's 2 a.m. You're running the numbers again. What you owe. What you earn. Call it the number loop. That IS the losing current.

Two streams run in your mind at all times. One pulls toward building. One pulls toward zero. Fear locks you into the one that destroys.

Men in 1929 lost decades of work in weeks because they could not stop that loop.

You can stop it right now. Choose your next thought on purpose.

Your feelings decide your future. Not your skills.

Your feelings are already running your financial future. Discipline, mindset, and self improvement for men who want real results.
